# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 01 Sep 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launches & Private Market

- **11 new launch condos still have units available from $1.38M** - Projects across CCR, RCR and OCR — including Vela Bay, Tengah Garden Residences and Narra Residences — still have units available in 2026, with entry prices starting from $1,377,095. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/10-new-launch-condos-from-2026-that-still-have-units-available-from-1-38m/)

- **Two new leasehold condos set to launch in September 2026** - Amberwood at Holland (District 10) and Lucerne Grand (beside Lakeside MRT) are both 99-year leasehold developments scheduled to launch this month. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/amberwood-at-holland-lucerne-grand-new-launch-september-2026/)

- **Singapore prime home prices up 0.4% in H1 2026, with stronger growth forecast for H2** - Savills data shows prime rents rose 1.7% in H1 2026, ahead of the 1.1% global average, with capital values forecast to grow between 2% and 3.9% in H2 2026 — among the strongest outlooks across 30 cities tracked. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-prime-home-prices-grew-0-4-first-half-2026-2-signs-point-stronger-second-half/)

- **Freehold Novena condo Gilstead Court launches fourth en bloc attempt at $198M** - The site could potentially yield around 98 units, though its low 1.4 plot ratio may present challenges for developers; three previous attempts since 2005 were unsuccessful. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/freehold-novena-condo-for-en-bloc-sale-198m-after-3-failed-attempts/)

## HDB Resale Records

- **Bedok 5-room flat sells for a record $1.45M** - A five-room flat at 153B Bedok South Road transacted at $1,450,000 ($1,192 psf) in August 2026, setting a new Bedok resale record and surpassing the previous record set at the same block just three months earlier. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/bedok-5-room-hdb-sold-record-1-45m-same-block-broke-record-3-months-ago/)

- **Pasir Ris records its first million-dollar 5-room flat at $1.15M** - A 5-room DBSS flat at Block 530D Pasir Ris Drive 1 sold for S$1.15 million, the first time a 5-room flat in Pasir Ris has crossed the million-dollar mark. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/pasir-ris-first-million-dollar-5-room-hdb-sale/)

- **Tampines DBSS flat sets new record at $1.12M** - A five-room DBSS unit at 519B Tampines Central 8 sold for $1,120,000 ($963 psf) in August 2026, setting a new price record for the flat type at the Centrale 8 development. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/tampines-dbss-flat-sold-for-record-1-12m-why-buyers-paying-premium/)
